critic.verdict: Nearly complete, but not ready to ship. I checked all 17 fixes on the list. Most were applied in substance: every escalation row E1 to E31 is present, D16 to D29 are numbered centrally, the cadence column is restored, and the economics battery, PQ-EPOCH, the per-user inbox, the commit-time floor and the steward set are all there. I fixed the problems an editor could fix in place: the E6 default had been silently contradicted in §0, the founder summary, §2.3 and P1b; adding 'attested' to the late-acceptance rule made PQB-HEAL fail under the spec's own defaults; P0.f's exit required a ruling, against the brief; ECON-DEPTH convicted §8.7's own example; and the L1 drill list, the suite floor before E23, the P0.a tooth and three claims above the ceiling were wrong. One blocking design defect remains. The fix-6 per-cell chain tag and the own-npub rule falsely flag every user with two or more devices, which is the default D = 2. It is now disclosed in §3.4 and §14 and has a control test, but needs redesign and an E6 ruling. Accessibility and voice, which brief §5 requires, are now disclosed but have no test family. The section 7 calculator was never saved as a file, and the evidence folder the citations point to has not landed in the repo.
